topics.headline: Next US CPI YoY to exceed 3.7
topics.summary: US CPI headline was 3.7% year-over-year in the reference month ending 2026-09-30. Prior month 3.4. US CPI index rose 0.2% from the prior month. US CPI food was 2.5% year-over-year in the reference month ending 2026-09-30. Prior month 2.7. US CPI shelter was 3.2% year-over-year in the reference month ending 2026-09-30. Prior month 3.0. US CPI energy was 3.8% year-over-year in the reference month ending 2026-09-30. Prior month 3.3.

evidence.point: US CPI headline was 3.7% year-over-year in the reference month ending 2026-09-30. Prior month 3.4.

gaps: No oil price on this feed. The energy row is the CPI energy index.
US CPI is monthly. The next print is the following month, not this week.

topics.headline: Next HICP > 4.0
topics.summary: Latest print 4.0 implies next release will exceed it based on 21.0 energy, 3.3 services, 2.6 core all rising from priors.

evidence.point: Eurozone HICP headline was 4.0% year-over-year in the reference month ending 2026-10-31. Prior month 3.8.
Eurozone HICP energy was 21.0% year-over-year in the reference month ending 2026-10-31. Prior month 19.0.
Eurozone HICP food was 1.5% year-over-year in the reference month ending 2026-10-31. Prior month 1.3.
Eurozone HICP services was 3.3% year-over-year in the reference month ending 2026-10-31. Prior month 3.2.
Eurozone HICP core was 2.6% year-over-year in the reference month ending 2026-10-31. Prior month 2.5.
